hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; pnpm biome check --write --no-errors-on-unmatched "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.css) node scripts/validate-ds-tokens.mjs "$f" 2>&1;; esac; } || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) case "$f" in src/migrations/*) exit 0;; esac; pnpm tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -50;; esac; } || true
